check: code snapshot against the baseline checkpoint
method: Built the model with build_mitunet(encoder_weights=None) from the code snapshot, loaded the checkpoint file on CPU and compared state-dict keys and tensor shapes. No training and no inference was run.

parameter_count.finding: The recorded model_parameter_count equals parameters plus buffers (all state-dict elements). The number of trainable parameters is 64,248,664.

what_this_shows: The snapshot's model definition produces the same architecture as the baseline checkpoint.
what_this_does_not_show: That the snapshot's training script, loss, data loading or augmentation are the code that trained the baseline.
That re-running the snapshot reproduces the baseline metrics. No re-run was made.
